note: USACE Coralville Lake campground on the east bank of the Iowa River below the dam, in hardwood woods; the west row backs onto the river bank. Fish-cleaning station and boat ramp to the river; the Devonian Fossil Gorge is across the river. Campers mention steep, narrow roads and low branches on the way in. --Claude
summary: Fees 22-24 -> 22-26 (50-amp sites E20-E24 are $26). Sites 28 -> 22 public RV sites (the 5 walk-to tent sites and the host site aren't reservable), max rig 50 -> 68, all back-in. Water/sewer cleared: the catalog shows them only on the host site. Added flush toilets, potable water, url, 14-night max. Riverfront kept: E10 and E12-E19 back onto the Iowa River bank. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT (riverfront kept): rec.gov carries no per-site waterfront attribute. Plotted rec.gov coordinates put the west row (E10, E12-E19; 42-50 ft, all fit 23 ft) ~15-25 m from the Iowa River's riprap bank with no road between (the campground road runs between the west and east rows); the river is ~120-130 m wide here, well over the creek line. The east row E20-E24 is across the road (view), the north loop E06-E09/E27/E28 is ~40-60 m from the bank (camper at E28: 'Great river view ... right on the river'). The below-dam rule doesn't apply: the value is the river's own.

HOOKUPS CONFLICT: rec.gov's description says 'full hook-up campsites', but the RIDB catalog lists water and sewer only on E11 (MANAGEMENT, not reservable); three 2026 camper reports (E21, E24, E28) say water no, sewer no. Water/sewer cleared to unknown (the host-site rule).

SEASON (not written): rec.gov peak rates run May 1-Oct 17 (2026 and 2027) and the fee booth is staffed May 1-Oct 31; no off-season rate rows, so the campground probably closes mid/late October, but no page states open/close dates.
PHONE: entry has no phone; rec.gov gives the campground fee booth (319) 338-3685 (May 1-Oct 31) and the Coralville Lake Project Office (319) 338-3543 x6300 (Nov 1-Apr 30).

ACCESS: 9/2026 camper: 'There are some steep narrow roads as you go into the campground'; 8/2026 (E21, motorhome): 'Low branches coming in either direction.' Not a stated limit; motorhomes stay there routinely. A note caveat is included.
MILITARY: rec.gov's militaryDiscount rule value is present but not written (not a discount claim).
PIN: stored 41.71990,-91.52850 sits in the middle of the two rows (sites' centre ~41.7201,-91.5285); fine. rec.gov's facility point (41.72438,-91.52606) is ~530 m north-east, at the dam.
